newsitem.title: USA: Kansas fed cattle market quiet, no sales - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas fed cattle market quiet, no sales - USDA.

text.p: DODGE CITY, July 7 (Reuder) - Trade was quiet, with no sales slaughter steers or heifers confirmed, USDA said.
Inquiry was moderate and demand rather light. Sales confirmed for the week to date including late Thursday and the holiday weekend on 4,000 head, mostly previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Monday bids $61.00-$62.00, with asking prices mostly $64.00. Last well established market was on Tuesday, July 1, with most sales at $63.00. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
